crossRefs.note: Naaman said, “Be pleased to take two talents.” He urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two…
So they sat down, ate, and drank, both of them together. Then the young lady’s father said to the man, “Please be…
Now therefore be pleased to look at me, for surely I will not lie to your face.
Barak said to her, “If you will go with me, then I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go.”

translations.web: One said, “Please be pleased to go with your servants.” He answered, “I will go.”
translations.bsb: Then one of them said, “Please come with your servants.” “I will come,” he replied.
translations.kjv: And one said, Be content, I pray thee, and go with thy servants. And he answered, I will go.
translations.asv: And one said, Be pleased, I pray thee, to go with thy servants. And he answered, I will go.
